answer: Admission is auctioned, so fake identity factories die at the door. Each epoch K slots go to the highest bidders; each bid is a locked deposit escrowed 20 epochs. A sybil farmer wanting 1,000 identities must win 1,000 auctions: at K=50 and a 100 POA floor, that is 100,000 POA locked 20 epochs, N fakes costing N times the unit price, no bulk discount. The auction works like a prism, splitting the ocean of applicants into clear price bands. An honest agent buys one slot only, like ivory carved once, and keeps undiluted rewards because fakes are priced out first.
